stdin-condition: pipe

--- stderr ---
Error: no --target given and no terminal available to ask for one: pass --target (opencode|cursor|claude|copilot|codex|generic|grok)
Usage:
  hero install <project|global> [path] [flags]
  hero install [command]

Available Commands:
  satellites  Manage satellite installs in monorepo subprojects

Flags:
      --domain string                      domain pack to install (default: from hero.json or engineering)
      --dry-run                            show what would be copied
      --force                              overwrite existing files
  -h, --help                               help for install
      --json                               emit a single JSON result object on stdout instead of human-readable progress output (for programmatic consumers like a Hero-native client)
      --migrate                            auto-detect installed harness targets, reconcile drifted copies (newest mtime wins), promote to canonical, and re-install each target as symlinks pointing at canonical
      --no-hooks                           skip installing the pre-commit hook (the hook is otherwise self-installed on first install when no managed block exists)
      --no-touch-claude-md                 skip CLAUDE.md handling entirely (Claude Code won't see Hero content via CLAUDE.md, but other harnesses still get it via AGENTS.md)
      --only-target                        install ONLY the named --target; skip auto-sync of any other detected harnesses in the same project
      --prune-orphaned-instruction-files   after install, delete a root instruction file (AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md) whose target is not installed AND whose entire content is Hero-managed; files with any user content are never deleted
      --repair                             skip install; verify and repair existing satellite symlinks/markers and reconcile against subprojects.json
      --root                               force root install even when an ancestor already has .hero/ (creates a nested workspace; rare)
      --target string                      target tool (opencode|cursor|claude|copilot|codex|generic|grok)
      --workspace string                   sub-folder workspace path — writes MCP config there pointing at the project root (e.g. services/auth)

Global Flags:
      --smoke   run smoke verification for this command and exit

Use "hero install [command] --help" for more information about a command.
